messages.author: 291cff2ebb484508
messages.subject: Monitor prioritization
parts:
Hello all,

Do you know if there is a direct way to monitor the different priorities assigned to entities during a simulation?

Currently I'm doing it by writing the priority in an attribute first, and then using that attribute when calling 'set_prioritization'. 

Thanks in advance,

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Monitor prioritization
parts:
Hi Francisco,

No, there's no other shortcut. Writing it to an attribute is the way to go.

Iñaki
